notes: F17: Reminders and simple cancellation are intended to help residents release reservations they no longer need; effectiveness has not been measured.
F21: The proposed 85% condition accepts either use or cancellation before the reservation starts. Timely release therefore satisfies this condition without counting as room use.
F17/F21: A cancellation records a released reservation, not attendance. Whether someone subsequently books or uses that slot remains unresolved.
